name: Awayuki no Shizuku
source: Set on a day when pale snowflakes drift through winter air, this game tells the story of a fateful meeting and the bonds that grow from it. The heroine, Haruna, is tormented by an eating disorder: she is frightened of food and convinced she cannot be forgiven unless she stays thin. Watching over her is Yūka, whose quiet support never wavers. They wound each other, cling to each other, and still try to keep moving forward. Following the inner struggles of four girls, the narrative unfolds as a “quiet yet searing tale of youth.”
